title: Effectiveness of Recent Measures Related to PMD Ownership and Use
what_it_is: Effectiveness of Recent Measures Related to PMD Ownership and Use

sections.label: E-scooter disposal cost and seizures
sections.summary: Questions asked the Minister for Transport about the cost of LTA's early disposal incentive and about illegally modified e-scooters.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Transport what is the estimated cost of LTA's early disposal incentive for e-scooters which do not meet the UL2272 safety standard and who will bear such costs.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Transport since the start of the mandatory registration of e-scooters in July 2019 (a) how many illegally modified e-scooters have been seized; (b) how does LTA keep check on e-scooter users who illegally modify their vehicles after being certified LTA-approved; and (c) whether the penalties will be enhanced for owners of illegally modified e-scooters.

sections.label: Non-compliant PMDs seized
sections.summary: LTA seized 161 non-compliant PMDs from July to September 2019, in reply to Er Dr Lee Bee Wah's query.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: To Er Dr Lee Bee Wah's query, LTA had seized 161 non-compliant PMDs from July to September 2019.

sections.label: Early disposal incentive scheme
sections.summary: The Government covers disposal costs and registered e-scooter owners get $100 if they dispose of devices before 30 November 2019.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Under the scheme, the Government covers the disposal costs and owners of registered e-scooters will qualify for an incentive of $100 if they dispose of their devices before 30 November 2019.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Between 23 September and 3 October 2019, LTA received more than 2,800 applications for the early disposal incentive scheme and collected more than 940 PMDs at the designated disposal points.

sections.label: Active Mobility Advisory Panel report
sections.summary: Some measures have been reflected in the recent Active Mobility Advisory Panel report, which is being studied and likely partly adopted.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Some of these have already been reflected in the Active Mobility Advisory Panel report that came out recently.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We are studying that and we are likely to adopt some of these measures.

sections.label: Compulsory device inspection
sections.summary: With compulsory inspection for each device, existing and incoming, action will be taken if an illegally modified device is detected.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Indeed, once we have our compulsory inspection for each device, both in terms of the existing devices and then, going forward, for each device that is brought in, we will take action if an illegally modified device is detected.

sections.label: New devices must comply
sections.summary: Steps already taken mean new devices and new imports need to be compliant and need to be registered.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The steps we have already taken will mean that new devices and new imports need to be compliant and need to be registered.
